_note: One record per published page. eyebrow/claim/support are the P8 slab's three parts; anchor is the exact string the claim rests on and must be present in the page as it ships. See claude/slab-claim-voice-and-rules.md.

exempt.index.html: carries the original P8 slab, written by hand and not owned by this pass
exempt.tools.html: 55 words; a link list with no figure of its own to anchor a claim to
exempt.calculators.html: an index of the tools; every figure it shows belongs to another page
exempt.concepts.html: a design-concept index, not a page that makes a claim to a reader
exempt.contact.html: a form; no figure, and a claim here would read as availability language
exempt.tycoon.html: a static visual-direction mockup, and its body carries no class to scope the slab to
exempt.rates.html: body class is ratespage and its editorial voice is excluded from the house passes by decision
exempt.questions.html: a complete index of the site's questions; every figure it shows belongs to another page
exempt.resources.html: the start-here index; every number on it is a headline borrowed from the page it links to

amft-3000-hours-california.html.claim: Almost nobody is waiting on the 3,000. An all-adult caseload is waiting on 500 relational hours.
amft-3000-hours-california.html.support: Four requirements, closing at different speeds. This projects all four from the week you actually work, and names the one you are waiting on. Not the total.
amft-3000-hours-california.html.mark: the one you are waiting on

associate-hours-telehealth-out-of-state..claim: Associate groups say you cannot finish your hours from another state. The Board has published the opposite five times.
associate-hours-telehealth-out-of-state..support: Five published answers. Four conditions, all of them ordinary. And one real risk, which is not the one people are worried about.
associate-hours-telehealth-out-of-state..anchor: The Board has published the opposite answer 5 times
associate-hours-telehealth-out-of-state..mark: not the one people are worried about

associate-mft-job-advisor.html.claim: The salary is the one number an offer letter gives you, and it is not the number that decides.
associate-mft-job-advisor.html.support: What you take home after tax. What an hour is really worth once notes and supervision are counted. And how fast this placement closes your 3,000 hours.
associate-mft-job-advisor.html.mark: how fast this placement closes your 3,000 hours

associate-therapist-pay-los-angeles-bay-.claim: A $70,000 associate salary sits $304 below the floor California law sets for a salaried-exempt job.
associate-therapist-pay-los-angeles-bay-.support: Three floors an offer has to clear, and the salary is only the first. Underneath are published pay scales from named employers, so you can check an offer against what the work actually pays.

associate-unpaid-hours-california.html.claim: The Board does not regulate what your supervisor pays you. Somebody else does, and filing costs nothing.
associate-unpaid-hours-california.html.support: Five separate things you can be owed, one of which the law may double. Three years to file. No fee, and no cost to the hours you have already banked.
associate-unpaid-hours-california.html.anchor: $0 to file, 3 years to do it
associate-unpaid-hours-california.html.mark: one of which the law may double

bbs-exam-pass-rates-california.html.claim: The California clinical exam passes 84% of people. It also passes 65%. Both figures are the Board's own.
bbs-exam-pass-rates-california.html.support: One counts first-time candidates and the other counts every attempt, and almost nobody quoting a rate says which. Seven quarters of both, for all seven exams.
bbs-exam-pass-rates-california.html.anchor: The pass rate is 84%. It is also 65%.
bbs-exam-pass-rates-california.html.mark: almost nobody quoting a rate says which

bbs-processing-times-california.html.claim: Getting registered got faster this year. Getting licensed got much slower, from 54 days to 96.
bbs-processing-times-california.html.support: The Board publishes this every quarter and nobody reads it. Both directions, quarter by quarter, and what one missing document adds to the wait.

become-an-mft-california.html.claim: Nothing here is somebody's summary of the rule. Every requirement is tied to the section that imposes it.
become-an-mft-california.html.support: The degree, the practicum, the 3,000 hours, supervision, both exams, and every fee at the rates that took effect on 1 July 2026. Where the Board publishes nothing, this page says so.
become-an-mft-california.html.mark: Where the Board publishes nothing, this page says so

continuing-education-california-lmft.htm.claim: The Board restarted audits in 2024, and 62% of the people it checked could not prove they had complied.
continuing-education-california-lmft.htm.support: Thirty-six hours every two years is the easy part. Proving you did them, two years later, is what people lose. The whole requirement, and the cheapest compliant way through it.
continuing-education-california-lmft.htm.mark: Proving you did them, two years later

for/associates.html.claim: The 3,000 is almost never what decides your date, and which requirement does changes what job you should take.
for/associates.html.support: Twenty-eight guides for the years between registration and the license. The hours, the hiring, the pay county by county, the loan repayment nobody mentions. Every figure from a named source.
for/associates.html.anchor: The 3,000 is almost never what decides your date

for/deciding.html.claim: The same clinical job pays 2.8 times more in one California county than in another.
for/deciding.html.support: Twelve guides for the decision itself. What the whole route costs and how long it really takes, how all 78 programs differ, and how crowded the field already is.
for/deciding.html.mark: how crowded the field already is

for/licensed.html.claim: Thirty-six CE hours every renewal, and an audit most people fail on paperwork rather than on hours.
for/licensed.html.support: Thirteen guides for the years the license actually pays. What your rate and caseload leave in the bank, what each panel reimburses per code, and whether the corporation beats the sole proprietorship on your numbers.
for/licensed.html.mark: whether the corporation beats the sole proprietorship

for/students.html.claim: Up to 1,300 of your pre-degree hours can bank toward the 3,000, and most students never count them.
for/students.html.support: Fourteen guides for the years between enrolling and your associate number. How the practicum actually works, who finds your site, and the two pieces of paperwork that start before you graduate.
for/students.html.mark: the two pieces of paperwork that start before you graduate

getting-hired-as-a-california-associate..claim: The bar is not your hour count. It is whether the setting is legally able to bill for your work.
getting-hired-as-a-california-associate..support: Two markets, and only one of them can hire you. That market also carries up to $180,000 of loan repayment that almost nobody mentions.

headway-alma-grow-therapy-compared-calif.claim: At twenty sessions a week, a network has to pay you $1.24 a session more than your own contracts do.
headway-alma-grow-therapy-compared-calif.support: None of the three publishes a California rate, so the decision is arithmetic you can do yourself. All four routes priced at ten, twenty and thirty sessions a week, with the crossover named.

hiring-first-associate-california-therap.claim: An associate costs about 1.10 times their salary, and starts paying for themselves at 14 sessions a week.
hiring-first-associate-california-therap.support: Payroll loading, plus one hour a week of your own billable time, which is the cost everybody forgets. And one classification question that has exactly one lawful answer.

insurance-panels-california-therapist.ht.claim: Eleven and a half hours of private pay beats twenty hours on a panel.
insurance-panels-california-therapist.ht.support: Once you price the unpaid hours a panel caseload drags behind it, the comparison changes. The sequence in order, the clock California law imposes, and which panels were open in August 2026.
insurance-panels-california-therapist.ht.mark: the unpaid hours a panel caseload drags behind it

insurance-reimbursement-rates-california.claim: Medicare and Medi-Cal publish their rates to the cent. Commercial payers and the networks publish nothing.
insurance-reimbursement-rates-california.support: So this page carries every figure a primary source establishes, the arithmetic that turns it into a year of income, and a plain list of what nobody can tell you.
insurance-reimbursement-rates-california.mark: a plain list of what nobody can tell you

loan-forgiveness-employers-california.ht.claim: Two of the four loan repayment programs reach a registered associate, and the employer you take decides which.
loan-forgiveness-employers-california.ht.support: One of them does not care what your license says. Another names associates outright. The job you accept opens and closes these before you have thought about them.
loan-forgiveness-employers-california.ht.mark: before you have thought about them

mbh-slrp-california.html.claim: California will repay up to $180,000 of an associate's loans, and asks 32 hours a week of direct care.
mbh-slrp-california.html.support: The three tiers, the obligation, and the tax question HCAI does not answer. In the first cycle, eligible demand was about 3.7 times the money available.
mbh-slrp-california.html.mark: the tax question HCAI does not answer

mft-programs-california.html.claim: The same license costs $37,800 at one California program and $152,340 at another.
mft-programs-california.html.support: Seventy-eight institutions, on published facts only. Degree, units, length, format, accreditation and cost, next to what students and graduates actually say in public.

out-of-state-to-california-licensure.htm.claim: Your license travels. Your transcript does not, and licensed time converts into hours only up to 1,200.
out-of-state-to-california-licensure.htm.support: Two routes in, and the deficiency letter does not say which one you are on. One asks for four courses. The other reopens your graduate degree.
out-of-state-to-california-licensure.htm.mark: The other reopens your graduate degree

psychedelic-therapy-training-california..claim: Sixteen trainings, from $1,047 to €15,000, and not one of them leads with what you may legally do afterwards.
psychedelic-therapy-training-california..support: So this page leads with it. What each costs, what you would study, and exactly what the certificate lets you do as a therapist licensed in California.
psychedelic-therapy-training-california..mark: So this page leads with it

psyd-programs-california.html.claim: California will license you without APA accreditation. The internship year very largely will not.
psyd-programs-california.html.support: Twenty-five doctorates in the state, grouped by the one fact that changes what the degree is worth. Twenty are APA-accredited. Five are not.

solo-401k-sep-simple-california-therapis.claim: At the same profit, a solo 401(k) shelters $24,500 a year more than a SEP does.
solo-401k-sep-simple-california-therapis.support: Two facts decide this, not seven. How much the practice makes, and whether you employ anyone. Worked at $80,000, $150,000 and $250,000 of profit, with the 20% rule derived rather than asserted.

therapist-discipline-cases-california.ht.claim: Discipline does not usually start with a client, and cost recovery is the number therapists most underestimate.
therapist-discipline-cases-california.ht.support: Forty-eight real Board decisions, de-identified. What happened, the exact subdivision it was charged under, and what each one cost the licensee.
therapist-discipline-cases-california.ht.mark: what each one cost the licensee

therapist-tax-deductions-california.html.claim: A real deduction saves 39 cents on the dollar. Four of the popular ones save nothing at all.
therapist-tax-deductions-california.html.support: A genuine expense comes off self-employment tax, federal income tax and California's rate at the same time, which is why $22,000 of expenses is worth $8,608 at $140,000 of gross.

therapist-tax-strategy-california.html.claim: On a $217,350 profit, $18,244 of the tax bill is optional. Not a loophole. Ordinary accounts.
therapist-tax-strategy-california.html.support: Each account's saving is measured by running the whole tax engine twice, not estimated from a bracket table. The only question is whether that money goes to the IRS or into an account with your name on it.
therapist-tax-strategy-california.html.mark: running the whole tax engine twice

therapists-by-county-california.html.claim: California publishes all 165,235 people on its register every month, to anyone who asks.
therapists-by-county-california.html.support: Counted by county and by license type, with the associate-per-supervisor ratio that shows where the competition for supervision actually is, and the delinquency rates nobody publishes.

therapy-liability-insurance-california.h.claim: The Board does not condition your license on liability insurance. Every payer and your landlord do.
therapy-liability-insurance-california.h.support: Eight programs a California MFT can buy, what each publishes, and what practitioners actually report paying. A $320 published premium against $110 to $600 reported.

associate-employers-bay-area.html.claim: The largest category of Bay Area associate employers is not on this page, because no public dataset names it.
associate-employers-bay-area.html.support: What is here is every employer that can be enumerated. Nine county behavioral health plans, 39 health-center organizations, 318 nonprofit agencies. Every one named, every link checked.
associate-employers-bay-area.html.mark: Every one named, every link checked

associate-hours-trackers-compared.html.claim: Three of the five hours trackers registered their domain this year, and four publish no named human being.
associate-hours-trackers-compared.html.support: The price is between $25 and $100 a year, and the price is not the decision. You are choosing a custodian for the only record of your 3,000 hours.

bbs-90-day-rule-california.html.claim: Miss the 90-day rule and 360 supervised hours you actually worked stop counting toward your 3,000.
bbs-90-day-rule-california.html.support: The default is that hours between your degree date and your associate number do not count. An application deadline and a fingerprint form change that, and both are settled before you start.
bbs-90-day-rule-california.html.mark: both are settled before you start

bbs-advertising-rules-2026.html.claim: Since April 2026 an associate's profile has to carry five elements, including an employer name and a supervision statement.
bbs-advertising-rules-2026.html.support: A licensee's ad carries three, an associate's five, a trainee's five including the supervisor's license number. And advertisement means your website and your directory bio too.
bbs-advertising-rules-2026.html.mark: your website and your directory bio too

becoming-a-therapist-california-career-c.claim: California graduates 5,309 people a year into this, up 66% since 2015 while all master's degrees grew 14%.
becoming-a-therapist-california-career-c.support: Not encouragement and not a warning. The pipeline, the three licenses compared on statute rather than temperament, an honest clock, and the three places the Board can see people leaving.
becoming-a-therapist-california-career-c.mark: Not encouragement and not a warning

county-job-portals-california.html.claim: For seven California counties the job portal you would guess belongs to a city or a court, not the county.
county-job-portals-california.html.support: All 58, with the wording on each destination that proves whose it is. And 48 of the 58 share one system, which is worth knowing before you make 58 accounts.
county-job-portals-california.html.mark: the wording on each destination that proves whose it is

county-therapist-pay-california.html.claim: The same clinical job pays $50,855 in one California county and $140,483 in another.
county-therapist-pay-california.html.support: Not a survey and not a job advert. This is what every county told the state it paid, for every position, three years running. 13,184 positions across 55 counties.
county-therapist-pay-california.html.mark: what every county told the state it paid

east-bay-practicum-site-directory.html.claim: Twenty-one East Bay practicum sites, three of which hire registered associates, every claim carrying its read date.
east-bay-practicum-site-directory.html.support: The per-site facts no state or federal file holds. Who was accepting students, hours, supervision, populations, school agreements, prerequisites, and a named contact for every site.
east-bay-practicum-site-directory.html.mark: no state or federal file holds

exam-prep-courses-california-compared.ht.claim: Prep costs more than the exam, and three vendors' pass-rate claims are three different kinds of sentence.
exam-prep-courses-california-compared.ht.support: The Board's exam fees are $75 and $125, and the test vendor charges you nothing. Prep runs $139 to $620. Only one of the three claims is the shape the Board's own number is.
exam-prep-courses-california-compared.ht.mark: the test vendor charges you nothing

finding-a-clinical-supervisor-california.claim: The Board certifies no supervisors and keeps no roster, and only 9 of the 23 CAMFT chapters publish a list.
finding-a-clinical-supervisor-california.support: So this is where the lists actually are, each one fetched and counted. Plus the rule that decides whether the person you find can lawfully supervise you at all.

practice-simulator.html.claim: Your rate and caseload are not your income. This works out what is actually left.
practice-simulator.html.support: Running costs, federal, state and self-employment tax, and the structure you trade under. Nothing starts at a figure somebody made up. It starts at zero, and at your rate.
practice-simulator.html.mark: It starts at zero, and at your rate
practice-simulator.html.why_before: the default slot is directly above the deep-pine newsletter band, where the slab's bottom scallop disappears into an identical green

aaci-san-jose.html.claim: AACI publishes an APA-accredited psychology internship at $26 an hour. It says nothing about MFT placement.
aaci-san-jose.html.support: Read off the organization's own pages on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether hours worked there will actually count.

about.html.claim: Built by a therapist, for California MFTs, LCSWs, LPCCs and psychologists. Free, and nothing on it is sold.
about.html.support: Calculators, rate research and plain-English notes on the parts of the job nobody trained you for. What is checked, how it is checked, and what is not sold here.
about.html.mark: the parts of the job nobody trained you for

affiliate-disclosure.html.claim: Two arrangements earn money on this site. Neither costs you anything, and neither changes a single figure.
affiliate-disclosure.html.support: Both listed in full, with what each one pays. Plus what was looked for and not found, and what is not done here at all.
affiliate-disclosure.html.mark: what was looked for and not found

alma-for-california-therapists.html.claim: Alma's $1,140 a year is not the price of being on Alma. Here is the arithmetic on a real caseload.
alma-for-california-therapists.html.support: A flat fee against a percentage, at 230, 460 and 690 sessions. The three payers you are required to join, and the Aetna cut that landed on 15 August 2026.

backdoor-roth-pro-rata-therapist.html.claim: The backdoor Roth is two easy steps. One old IRA balance makes most of the conversion taxable.
backdoor-roth-pro-rata-therapist.html.support: It measures every traditional, SEP and SIMPLE IRA you own, on a date you will not think about. Worked on real numbers, with the escape hatch and its deadline.
backdoor-roth-pro-rata-therapist.html.mark: on a date you will not think about

bbs-fees-california-2026.html.claim: Every Board fee halved on 1 July 2026. The whole route now costs between $575 and $875.
bbs-fees-california-2026.html.support: What the headline number leaves out is how many years you spend as an associate. Priced year by year, with the reversion date that ends it.
bbs-fees-california-2026.html.mark: the reversion date that ends it

becoming-a-clinical-supervisor-californi.claim: Supervising for a fee and employing an associate are not the same decision, and the economics are different.
becoming-a-clinical-supervisor-californi.support: Two separate two-year eligibility tests, and almost everybody checks only the first. Then fifteen training hours, six more each renewal, and clinical work that becomes yours to answer for.
becoming-a-clinical-supervisor-californi.mark: almost everybody checks only the first

buckelew-programs.html.claim: Buckelew publishes no program page. One passing mention of internships, an AMFT on staff, and a benefits page.
buckelew-programs.html.support: The North Bay's largest nonprofit mental health provider since 1970, and that is everything its site says about training. The three questions that protect your hours are here.
buckelew-programs.html.mark: The three questions that protect your hours

california-therapy-bills-2026.html.claim: Two bills would change what California associates and therapists have to do. Neither one is law yet.
california-therapy-bills-2026.html.support: AB 1598 would stop associates retaking the Law and Ethics exam every year. SB 903 writes the first rules on using AI in a practice, with a $10,000 penalty behind them.

caminar.html.claim: Caminar's careers page describes school-based work at 20 to 40 paid clinical hours a week.
caminar.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether those hours will count toward your 3,000.
caminar.html.anchor: 20 to 40 hours of paid clinical work per week

center-for-mindful-psychotherapy.html.claim: Roughly 125 associate MFTs, and the collective is the associates rather than a program standing beside them.
center-for-mindful-psychotherapy.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours you work there will count.

changes.html.claim: Every figure on this site that has moved, with the date it moved and the source it came from.
changes.html.support: Not a list of pages published. A log of numbers that changed — fees, limits, rates, panel status, accreditation. On a site whose claim is that the figures are checked, this is the proof.

client-records-california-therapist.html.claim: Seven years from termination, inspection in five working days, copies in fifteen, at 25 cents a page.
client-records-california-therapist.html.support: The clock starts when therapy ends, not when the file was opened. Plus the summary option, and the three duties that attach the moment you decline.

contra-costa-crisis-center.html.claim: What the Contra Costa Crisis Center publishes is a 54-hour volunteer track with a year-long shift commitment.
contra-costa-crisis-center.html.support: Which is not the same thing as a clinical practicum, and will not bank hours toward your 3,000. Read off its own site, dated.

cost-of-incorporating-california-therapi.claim: The corporation costs $800 whether or not you made anything, and the first-year rule is usually stated backwards.
cost-of-incorporating-california-therapi.support: Everyone quotes the self-employment tax an S election saves. Far fewer quote the floor that arrives regardless, or the profit at which 1.5% overtakes it.

crisis-support-services-alameda.html.claim: Its site describes interns obtaining hours for licensure, and supervision of both trainees and associates.
crisis-support-services-alameda.html.support: A 24-hour crisis line running since 1966. Read off its own pages on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours count.

east-bay-agency-for-children.html.claim: EBAC publishes a grief-focused MSW practicum. Its pages do not address MFT placement at all.
east-bay-agency-for-children.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours would count toward your 3,000.

eden-housing-resident-services.html.claim: A housing organization whose IRS code lands near mental health, and whose site carries no clinical content.
eden-housing-resident-services.html.support: That code is why it turns up in behavioral health datasets at all. Its own pages carry nothing about training. Read on a dated read.
eden-housing-resident-services.html.mark: why it turns up in behavioral health datasets

edgewood-center.html.claim: A site search for internship returns nothing, so this question has to go to Edgewood directly.
edgewood-center.html.support: More than 15 programs across six Bay Area locations, and nothing published about training toward a license. The three questions that protect your hours are here.
edgewood-center.html.mark: The three questions that protect your hours

family-paths.html.claim: Family Paths runs an intern program, and its own site announces that the program pauses at the end of August 2026.
family-paths.html.support: Which is exactly the kind of thing a directory will not tell you. Read off its own site, dated, with the three questions that decide whether hours count.
family-paths.html.anchor: Program pause announced for the end of August 2026

fred-finch-youth-center.html.claim: Fred Finch's Training Institute is continuing education for licensed clinicians, not a route to a license.
fred-finch-youth-center.html.support: Serving youth and families since 1891, and the training it publishes is for people who already have a license. Read off its own site, dated.

grow-therapy-for-california-therapists.h.claim: Grow publishes exactly one fee, and it is not the one that decides what you earn.
grow-therapy-for-california-therapists.h.support: It is the fastest of the three to credential you and the only one carrying Medi-Cal managed care. What each 1% of your billings costs is priced here, because Grow will not name its own.
grow-therapy-for-california-therapists.h.mark: What each 1% of your billings costs

grow-your-therapy-practice.html.claim: A client who stays twenty-four sessions is worth $4,800. Change how many stay, and a whole year moves.
grow-your-therapy-practice.html.support: Six numbers, most of which you can estimate from memory: what a client is worth, where they come from, and how many enquiries a month it takes just to stand still.

headway-for-california-therapists.html.claim: Headway charges $0 a month and keeps an undisclosed share of every reimbursement. You cannot see the rate until you are credentialed.
headway-for-california-therapists.html.support: Checked line by line against Headway's own help center, including the license list that rules out every associate in California.

home-office-deduction-california-therapi.claim: The room is worth less than most therapists hope. Qualifying for it turns every drive afterwards from commute into deduction.
home-office-deduction-california-therapi.support: Both methods run on stated numbers, actual expenses against the simplified $5 a square foot, plus three traps, each with a citation.

how-to-find-a-practicum-site-california..claim: At 29 of California's 78 MFT programs, nobody says whose job it is to find your practicum site.
how-to-find-a-practicum-site-california..support: What your program owes you by law, the settings the law rules out, the four places seats actually exist, and the questions to ask before you accept one.

is-therapy-financially-viable-california.claim: A $70,304 associate floor, and $138,940 net from a full private caseload. Both are real, and years apart.
is-therapy-financially-viable-california.support: The degree is the whole price of admission; everything after it is cheap. Walked county by county, gross to bank account, with every figure computed on the page.

jfcs-east-bay.html.claim: JFCS East Bay publishes no practicum or trainee page. What it does publish is an employer profile.
jfcs-east-bay.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether hours worked there would count toward your 3,000.

john-muir-behavioral-health.html.claim: The only residencies John Muir publishes are physician and pharmacy tracks. Neither one banks hours toward an MFT license.
john-muir-behavioral-health.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether hours worked there would count toward your 3,000.

lincoln-families.html.claim: Lincoln Families publishes a practicum page with the supervision hours itemized and a $4,000 first-year educational reimbursement.
lincoln-families.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours you work there will count.

medi-cal-safety-net-employers-california.claim: 218 health center organizations across 3,038 sites, plus the 57 agencies that run Medi-Cal specialty mental health.
medi-cal-safety-net-employers-california.support: Every link on the state's own page was checked before publication, and four things this list is not are stated before the list starts.
medi-cal-safety-net-employers-california.mark: four things this list is not

momentum-for-health.html.claim: Momentum for Health publishes a practicum and field placement page, described as paid, across outpatient, residential and PHP settings.
momentum-for-health.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours will count toward your 3,000.

newsletter.html.claim: One email a month, when a fee, rate or limit on this site moves. Nothing else.
newsletter.html.support: What is new here and what changed in the numbers, plus better ways to run the money side. A past issue is shown in full before you decide.

one-life-counseling-center.html.claim: One Life describes paid trainee and associate roles, six supervision groups, and explicit Spanish-language capacity.
one-life-counseling-center.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours you work there will count.

peninsula-healthcare-connection.html.claim: No training page was found. The behavioral health team Peninsula Healthcare Connection describes is licensed-level.
peninsula-healthcare-connection.html.support: Fifteen years of street-level healthcare in Palo Alto, and nothing published about training toward a license. Read dated, with the three questions that protect your hours.

practicum-california-mft-trainee.html.claim: 29 of 78 California MFT programs publish nothing about placement, and only one license lets you bank the 1,300 hours.

therapist-cost-of-living-california.html.support: Housing, transport, food and medical by county, plus the student loan under RAP, IBR and PSLF as the rules stand after 1 July 2026.

therapist-llc-california.html.claim: You cannot form an LLC for a licensed practice in California. Cal. Corp. Code 17701.04(e) is the sentence that says so.
therapist-llc-california.html.support: So we go and read the sentence, then the two structures actually left to you, who is allowed to own one, and how the name is constrained.

therapist-working-remotely-california.ht.claim: Your license is not the obstacle. The same practice, same clients, same profit is worth $18,700 more in the best of eight.
therapist-working-remotely-california.ht.support: The Board's own telehealth answer, quoted, then eight places priced on your own numbers, and why the tax follows the passport rather than the address.

therapynotes-vs-simplepractice-californi.claim: Fifteen systems, from free to $99 a month for one clinician, and one that publishes no price at all.

training-programs-bay-area.html.claim: Of the 24 largest Bay Area clinical nonprofits, ten publish a real training program. Four of those say what it pays.

translifeline.html.claim: Trans Lifeline's site says credit may be possible case by case. That is not the same as hours that count.

westcoast-childrens-clinic.html.claim: WestCoast publishes an eight-month compensated MSW and MFT program with its partner schools named, plus doctoral tracks.
westcoast-childrens-clinic.html.support: Read off its own site on a dated read, with the three questions that decide whether the hours you work there will count.

money/index.html.claim: What to charge, sole proprietor or corporation, how much to defer, and what to send quarterly. Everything else follows those four.

licensure/index.html.claim: 3,000 supervised hours over at least 104 weeks is the requirement that sets the calendar. The other four close faster.
licensure/index.html.support: 126 pages and a directory of all 78 California programs, priced and dated, with what the Board charges now that fees have halved to $875.

psychedelic-training-ciis-psychedelic-as.claim: Twelve months and about $9,000 that teaches you psilocybin and MDMA, and still leaves you legally limited to ketamine.
psychedelic-training-ciis-psychedelic-as.support: The oldest and largest university-based psychedelic training in the country, priced and dated, with what the certificate actually permits in California.

psychedelic-training-ciis-psychedelic-st.claim: This is a bachelor's degree completion, not a facilitator training. If you already hold a clinical license it is the wrong purchase.
psychedelic-training-ciis-psychedelic-st.support: Three semesters at $1,028 a unit, the first undergraduate psychedelics degree in the country, and why it is the wrong purchase for a licensee.

psychedelic-training-embody-lab-somatic-.claim: A $1,047 self-paced certificate in somatic preparation, sitting and integration. It changes no one's scope of practice.
psychedelic-training-embody-lab-somatic-.support: Thirty-six hours across three modules, open to licensed and unlicensed alike. Priced, dated, and held to what it says about itself.

psychedelic-training-fluence-training.ht.claim: Three certificates at $5,500 to $7,000, all requiring a psychotherapy license. Only the Colorado psilocybin pathway leads to state standing.
psychedelic-training-fluence-training.ht.support: Built explicitly for licensed clinicians working inside current law, with APA continuing education on all three and what each one actually permits.

psychedelic-training-innertrek.html.claim: The only certificate in this directory a regulator recognizes. The license it leads to stops at the Oregon state line.
psychedelic-training-innertrek.html.support: On the Oregon Health Authority's approved-curriculum list, with the forty-hour practicum, the price, and the service center closure of June 2026.

psychedelic-training-integrative-psychia.claim: 140 online hours that state plainly they are not approved for Oregon or Colorado licensure, until you add the Eugene practicum.
psychedelic-training-integrative-psychia.support: The separate $3,000 psilocybin practicum is what puts the combined program on Oregon's approved list. Priced and dated, with what each part carries.

psychedelic-training-mind-foundation-apt.claim: Fifteen months and three residential weeks in Berlin, and it confers nothing legally in the United States.
psychedelic-training-mind-foundation-apt.support: Explicitly anti-underground and demanding, with a supervised personal-experience component that is lawful there and not here. Priced and dated.

psychedelic-training-naropa-psilocybin-f.claim: One of the rare trainings that can end in a state license. Another organization runs it now, Colorado only.
psychedelic-training-naropa-psilocybin-f.support: Who runs it now, which state still takes it, which state it dropped, and the 150 hours Colorado's rules require it to cover. It publishes no price.

psychedelic-training-pacifica-psychedeli.claim: Two $1,095 online continuing education series through a depth-psychology lens. No practicum, and no state approval anywhere.
psychedelic-training-pacifica-psychedeli.support: A strong faculty roster and a real subject, sold as a certificate series. What it is, what it is not, priced and dated.

psychedelic-training-polaris-insight-kap.claim: Modular ketamine training from a San Francisco clinic working since 2018. A usable foundation costs $1,950, and the certificate is optional.
psychedelic-training-polaris-insight-kap.support: Priced module by module, so you can see what the cheapest real entry into this work actually costs before committing to a year.

psychedelic-training-prati.html.claim: Four residential days in Colorado whose main draw is two physician-supervised ketamine sessions for the trainees themselves.
psychedelic-training-prati.html.support: $3,000 for non-physicians, no continuing education credit, and no state facilitator standing. Priced and dated, with what that leaves you holding.

psychedelic-training-psychedelic-coaliti.claim: APA-sponsored continuing education that counts for a California LMFT, from a program that has stopped taking applications.
psychedelic-training-psychedelic-coaliti.support: A residential Los Angeles training built around taking ketamine yourself and sitting for a peer. $5,000, and apparently dormant as of August 2026.

psychedelic-training-soundmind-institute.claim: Twelve months mostly online, still on Colorado's approved list, and no longer on Oregon's despite being one of the first three approved.
psychedelic-training-soundmind-institute.support: So the Colorado track leads somewhere real and the Oregon one does not. Priced from $5,800, dated, with what the change means for you.
psychedelic-training-soundmind-institute.mark: what the change means for you

psychedelic-training-spiral-process-trai.claim: Six days in Santa Cruz, run by one LMFT, with two ketamine sessions for you as a student included in the $1,950.
psychedelic-training-spiral-process-trai.support: Small, in person, and specific about what it covers. Priced and dated, with what it does and does not confer.

psychedelic-training-uc-berkeley-bcsp.ht.claim: Nine months and $14,000 from a major public university, Oregon-approved, and not admitting anyone since 2025.
psychedelic-training-uc-berkeley-bcsp.ht.support: Chaplaincy-flavored and genuinely distinctive, with no announced restart. The pause statement and the fee are both quoted from Berkeley's own page.

psychedelic-training-vital-psychedelics-.claim: $10,500 for twelve remote months, no clinical degree required, and a certificate with no legal force anywhere.
psychedelic-training-vital-psychedelics-.support: Which leaves the network and the education as the whole of what you are buying. Priced and dated, with the separate mentorship add-on named.
psychedelic-training-vital-psychedelics-.mark: the whole of what you are buying

discipline-case-a-battery-conviction-and.claim: A battery conviction outside working hours ended a registration. Not answering the accusation was a second decision, with its own deadline.
discipline-case-a-battery-conviction-and.support: Report any arrest or charge to the Board in writing within 30 days, and keep your address of record current: service there is effective whether you read it or not.
discipline-case-a-battery-conviction-and.mark: whether you read it or not

discipline-case-a-decade-of-employer-war.claim: Four employers acted on him before the Board ever did. Eleven years of it arrived in a single accusation.
discipline-case-a-decade-of-employer-war.support: Registration surrendered, no reinstatement, and $33,704 in cost recovery. Write your contact rules into the intake and put every text into the record.

discipline-case-a-felony-assault-and-a-d.claim: A revocation that turned as much on a missed 15-day deadline as on the felony conviction behind it.
discipline-case-a-felony-assault-and-a-d.support: The Board's jurisdiction survives an expired registration, and service to your address of record is effective whether or not you read it. Costs came to $4,551.25.

discipline-case-a-forty-year-license-sur.claim: Licensed since the 1980s, surrendered after one DUI. Surrender ends the proceeding and usually forecloses reinstatement.
discipline-case-a-forty-year-license-sur.support: At that stage of a career the choice between fighting and surrendering is an economic one, and the $2,090 in costs is the smallest number in it.

discipline-case-a-mandated-report-never-.claim: A year of abuse disclosures and no report filed. The duty is yours personally, and suspicion triggers it, not certainty.
discipline-case-a-mandated-report-never-.support: Never route a suspected abuse report through a physician, a school, or the non-offending parent. Discipline on one healing arts license travels to the other.

discipline-case-almost-forty-years-of-re.claim: A 1985 murder conviction, and a 2024 registration granted on probation. The applicant carries the burden, and met it.
discipline-case-almost-forty-years-of-re.support: What the Board weighed, and how to assemble a record that maps onto the regulation: sentence completed, parole clean, and the whole history disclosed first.

discipline-case-asking-a-client-where-to.claim: Fifty-four sessions of ordinary work create no store of credit. The record is one text message thread.
discipline-case-asking-a-client-where-to.support: Asking a client not to report you is not damage control, it is an additional charge. Registration surrendered, with $8,107 in costs.

discipline-case-billed-for-sessions-that.claim: Twenty-two sessions billed for a patient seen twice, charged under five subdivisions at once, plus a records-destruction count.
discipline-case-billed-for-sessions-that.support: Reconcile every claim against your calendar and your notes before it goes out. The seven-year clock runs from termination of therapy, not from settlement.

discipline-case-cannabis-with-a-client.h.claim: He smoked with a client, drove her home impaired, and offered her Xanax. A refused offer is still cause for discipline.
discipline-case-cannabis-with-a-client.h.support: He used the phrase not therapy himself to describe the outings. It appears in the accusation as an admission, and his own words did most of the Board's work.

discipline-case-charged-without-a-convic.claim: Charged for conduct that was never prosecuted, and disciplined for it anyway. Do not assume a charge that goes away goes away.
discipline-case-charged-without-a-convic.support: Tell your criminal defense attorney you hold a license at the first meeting, and get a licensing attorney involved before any plea.

discipline-case-denied-it-then-admitted-.claim: She denied it to her employer and admitted it two days later. Those two days are why this went to a hearing.
discipline-case-denied-it-then-admitted-.support: One of the very few cases in this library proved at a full hearing by clear and convincing evidence, so it shows what the standard actually looks like.
discipline-case-denied-it-then-admitted-.mark: what the standard actually looks like

discipline-case-discipline-follows-your-.claim: The psychology board acted and the MFT license followed. The facts settled in the first proceeding became conclusive in the second.
discipline-case-discipline-follows-your-.support: Dual-licensed clinicians consistently underestimate this, and it is not a re-hearing. A stipulation in another state is not a private arrangement.

discipline-case-disciplined-for-emails.h.claim: No meetings, no money, no sex. An email correspondence alone drew three years of probation and $7,644 in costs.
discipline-case-disciplined-for-emails.h.support: Two habits are chargeable on this record: terms of endearment, and directive instructions about how a client should spend an evening. Both feel like care.

discipline-case-drinking-at-lunch.html.claim: No client complaint, no harm alleged, no pattern. Alcohol at lunch, then a session and a group, and four years of probation.
discipline-case-drinking-at-lunch.html.support: The sessions he went ahead and held are the misconduct, not the drink at lunch. If you are impaired at work, cancel the schedule and tell someone who can cover.

discipline-case-eight-weeks-without-a-th.claim: Eight weeks without a Board-approved therapist, and a year added to a four-year probation.
discipline-case-eight-weeks-without-a-th.support: Probation is usually lost to administrative slippage rather than misconduct, and the slippage costs real time. The requirement does not pause while you look for someone new.

discipline-case-eight-years-of-escalatio.claim: Eight years with one client through three levels of licensure, ending in four sessions on MDMA. Nobody ever saw the work.
discipline-case-eight-years-of-escalatio.support: The controlled-substance provision has no clinical-context exception, which matters to anyone working near psychedelic-assisted practice. Look for the first unusual act, not the first bad one.

discipline-case-embezzlement-outside-the.claim: 62 checks written at a bookkeeping job, and a registration revoked. No connection to therapy at all.
discipline-case-embezzlement-outside-the.support: The test is the relationship test in the regulation, not whether it happened at work. The Board learns about convictions automatically, through the Department of Justice.
discipline-case-embezzlement-outside-the.mark: not whether it happened at work

discipline-case-failing-to-report-your-o.claim: A reckless driving conviction charged six times over, including one cause for not reporting it within 30 days.
discipline-case-failing-to-report-your-o.support: The reportable event is the conviction, not the arrest. If you hold a second registration, notify both: there is no shared record between the two files.

discipline-case-falsified-course-certifi.claim: A probation that was substantively survivable and collapsed over paperwork, payments, and how the respondent handled being caught.
discipline-case-falsified-course-certifi.support: On the day you sign your orientation notes, put every proposal date, coursework date, quarterly report and payment into the calendar you use for clients.
discipline-case-falsified-course-certifi.mark: the calendar you use for clients

discipline-case-felony-child-endangermen.claim: The Board took every allegation as true without hearing a word from the respondent. Not answering is itself the losing move.
discipline-case-felony-child-endangermen.support: Calendar 30 days from any plea or verdict, even when the charge is a wobbler that will be reduced later and your criminal lawyer treats the matter as closed.
discipline-case-felony-child-endangermen.mark: even when the charge is a wobbler

discipline-case-forged-supervisor-signat.claim: The supervisor had died, and the hours still needed signing. A regulation exists for exactly that situation.
discipline-case-forged-supervisor-signat.support: If a supervisor dies, leaves, or refuses to sign, there is a documented alternative route to proving your hours. Start the paperwork the week it happens.

discipline-case-four-ways-to-violate-pro.claim: Four ways to violate probation, and one of them is simply not paying the bill from the first order.
discipline-case-four-ways-to-violate-pro.support: Negotiate a payment schedule into the order at the settlement stage. And file the quarterly reports even in quarters where nothing happened.
discipline-case-four-ways-to-violate-pro.mark: even in quarters where nothing happened

discipline-case-from-dui-to-surrender.ht.claim: Conviction, five years of probation, then surrender seven months in. Roughly one probation in five fails.
discipline-case-from-dui-to-surrender.ht.support: In the Board's own figures, 18 to 28 probations are revoked each year against 74 to 132 probationers. Take the terms as a five-year operating constraint, not paperwork.

discipline-case-ignoring-an-order-to-be-.claim: Comply with the order and fight the conclusion. Those are two different things, and only the first has a 30-day deadline.
discipline-case-ignoring-an-order-to-be-.support: Three cases in one, and in the first the accusation contains no clinical charge of any kind. Call a licensing attorney the day the order arrives, not the week it expires.

discipline-case-letting-a-registration-l.claim: Her registration lapsed while she was on probation for it, and the probation was reimposed for 42 months on expanded terms.
discipline-case-letting-a-registration-l.support: A probation can be reopened and lengthened with no new clinical misconduct at all. Renew on time even while suspended, between jobs, or not practicing.

discipline-case-out-of-state-discipline..claim: Disciplined in Arizona, surrendered in California. No California client was required for any of it.
discipline-case-out-of-state-discipline..support: An inactive out-of-state license still generates discipline you must report here, and a renewal you forget is a lapse that can itself be charged.

discipline-case-probation-traded-for-sur.claim: A 0.15 breath test, a below-guideline probation earned by a real rehabilitation record, and the true price of surrendering mid-probation.
discipline-case-probation-traded-for-sur.support: Report a conviction within 30 days of the plea even when the Department of Justice has already told them, and answer a Board letter inside the window it states.

discipline-case-pseudonyms-and-sleepover.claim: Choosing pseudonyms for clients is an act of concealment, and concealment is the reliable signal that the person already knows.
discipline-case-pseudonyms-and-sleepover.support: Eight causes for discipline, and the clearest statement of the California dual-relationship standard anywhere in this library. It is auditable against your own practice.

discipline-case-psychology-probation-rea.claim: One set of clinical facts produced discipline on two licenses, plus a separate charge for saying nothing about the first.
discipline-case-psychology-probation-rea.support: If you hold a second license or registration, report to every board that licenses you on the day discipline becomes effective, and send it with proof of delivery.

discipline-case-road-rage-and-a-default-.claim: Two misdemeanors from a parking-lot argument would have been a contested case. The silence turned it into a revocation with no hearing.
discipline-case-road-rage-and-a-default-.support: Report any conviction in writing within 30 days without waiting for sentencing, expungement, or your criminal lawyer to finish.

discipline-case-serious-felonies-ignore-.claim: A 2008 conviction still reached a 2024 application, because a serious felony does not age out of the seven-year window.
discipline-case-serious-felonies-ignore-.support: Check Penal Code section 1192.7 before you rely on that window. It includes any felony involving personal use of a weapon.

discipline-case-seven-business-practice-.claim: An outright revocation, no stay and no probation, and not one clinical allegation in the whole accusation.
discipline-case-seven-business-practice-.support: Six sessions on a lapsed license turned an ordinary billing dispute into this. The failure-to-cooperate count is available in every case, at the same penalty range.

discipline-case-seven-years-under-superv.claim: Seven years on probation and counting. When you price a disciplinary matter, price the probation, not the hearing.
discipline-case-seven-years-under-superv.support: Roughly $1,200 a year in monitoring, coursework that does not count toward continuing education, and telling every employer. Tolling stops the clock and moves the end date.

discipline-case-sex-with-a-residential-c.claim: The clinical director who slept with an inpatient, then asked him for $5 million. Every other case here sits below it.
discipline-case-sex-with-a-residential-c.support: Seven years of probation, the maximum the guidelines set, and the largest cost recovery in three years of California discipline. The detail to carry away is the $14,500.

discipline-case-signed-her-supervisors-n.claim: She wrote her supervisor's name on the hours forms, admitted it, and was still given a supervised route back into practice.
discipline-case-signed-her-supervisors-n.support: The rare case where the Board rejected its own judge's proposed decision and decided the matter itself. Never supply another person's name on a Board document.

discipline-case-the-address-of-record.ht.claim: An address the Board could not reach is the structural reason so many other cases carry a failure-to-cooperate count.
discipline-case-the-address-of-record.ht.support: Update it within 30 days of moving, in BreEZe, separately from your public practice address. Do the same with your carrier and your supervisor of record.
discipline-case-the-address-of-record.ht.mark: separately from your public practice address

discipline-case-the-custody-letter.html.claim: A letter written about a client for someone who was not the client. Three separate rules break in one case.
discipline-case-the-custody-letter.html.support: Each is a rule ordinary therapists get asked to break every year. If you amend a record, amend it visibly: date it, mark it, and keep the original.

discipline-case-the-only-public-reproval.claim: The mildest formal discipline available, and the only one issued to an MFT in three years of data.

discipline-case-the-slow-boil.html.claim: Three years of small decisions, each defensible against the one before it and indefensible against the first.
discipline-case-the-slow-boil.html.support: The tell available at any point was structural, not moral: sessions running for hours, at night, with daily texting between them.

discipline-case-the-two-year-rule-is-not.claim: We could date if we ended therapy. This case is what that misunderstanding costs.
discipline-case-the-two-year-rule-is-not.support: A client's disclosure of romantic feelings is clinical material. Naming it, keeping it in the room and documenting it was the obvious and cheap alternative.

discipline-case-thirty-days-to-report-di.claim: The reporting duty is the single most frequently missed obligation in this entire library, and it made everything else worse.
discipline-case-thirty-days-to-report-di.support: Put a 30-day reminder in your calendar the day anything reportable happens, and report in writing so you have proof of the date. Report even when you think they know.

discipline-case-thirty-four-year-sentenc.claim: A 34-year sentence, then a social work application, and a registration issued on probation rather than a permanent no.
discipline-case-thirty-four-year-sentenc.support: The seven-year window runs from release rather than conviction. The Board fingerprints every applicant, so what you control is whether your account arrives with the record.

discipline-case-three-days-after-the-las.claim: Coffee three days after the final session. The reason he gave for not consulting his supervisor is the usual one.
discipline-case-three-days-after-the-las.support: Every supervision relationship should survive the disclosure that a supervisee is having a reaction to a client. If yours cannot, that is a fact about the placement.

discipline-case-twenty-three-sessions-in.claim: 23 sessions billed in a single day, plus a separate count for not reporting the conviction behind it.

discipline-case-two-duis-five-years-prob.claim: Two DUIs and five years of probation. This is the most common California MFT discipline case, and almost nobody expects it.
discipline-case-two-duis-five-years-prob.support: Reporting it yourself within 30 days is the difference between two counts and three. Understand what probation involves before you decide whether to fight.

discipline-case-two-nursing-actions-befo.claim: Two nursing board actions in under three years became the entire substance of a behavioral sciences application case.
discipline-case-two-nursing-actions-befo.support: The Board obtains certified copies regardless, and a certified copy is conclusive proof. Disclose every action yourself and attach the decisions.

discipline-case-underground-psychedelics.claim: He dosed two clients and slept with one. The controlled-substance charge stands entirely on its own, independent of that.
discipline-case-underground-psychedelics.support: Do not take on anyone you already hold authority over. Keep sessions to a scheduled length and end them in the office: rides home and shared meals are the observable markers.
